query:
SELECT s.id, s.clientId, s.type, s.value, s.dueDay, s.startDate, s.status, s.created_at,
       COUNT(sc.id) as charges_count
FROM subscriptions s
LEFT JOIN subscription_charges sc ON sc.subscription_id = s.id
WHERE s.created_at >= '2026-03-17 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
